searchText: Is anyone opposed to removing the `created` field from EIP metadata? It is redundant with git history. Is there a good way to work out when EIPs get merged for the first time as draft EIPs? Currently most EIPs get manually included in Week in Ethereum News when the PR is created (unless it is a draft PR) Do you mean merged as drafts? It is helpful in seeing at a glance just how very old some EIPs are 😉 The number gives you a relative sense of age. How old a standard is shouldn't matter much though. The TCP standard is still super useful today, even though it is much older than some newer standards (for example). Note the winking smiley. Would an EIP around JSON metadata for NFTs be an ERC or Informational in your opinions? On the one hand, it sounds ERC-like, and both EIP-721 and EIP-1155 have sections for JSON metadata, but on the other the JSON metadata itself is not (generally) stored on-chain, so that made me think maybe it's informational just by virtue of not really pertaining to a contract standard or anything else strictly on-chain. I hate informational. So my vote is ERC.
